claim.claim-text: 1. A method of operating a wireless terminal, UE, (3330) connected to a network node (3320) associated to a serving cell of a radio access network, RAN, the method comprising:

2. The method of the preceding claim, wherein the CGI report includes a SIB1 presence field indicative that the SIB1 is absent and further comprises a cell identifier information field, wherein an empty cell identifier information field indicates that the UE was not able to detect the CGI of the neighbor cell.
3. The method of the preceding claims 1-2, further comprising stopping the timer upon transmitting the CGI report.
4. The method of claim 1, further comprising:

• transmitting (603) a measurement report to the network node, wherein the measurement report includes a physical cell identifier, PCI, for the neighbor cell; and receiving (607) a request from the network node to report the CGI of the neighbour cell, wherein the request includes the PCI for the neighbour cell.
5. The method of claim 4, wherein the PCI is encoded in a synchronization signal transmitted by the neighbour cell.

6. The method of claim 1, wherein the timer is a T321 timer, and wherein if the UE succeeds within the duration of the timer to determine the CGI, information about the CGI is included in the CGI report.

7. The method of any of claims 1-6, wherein the system information comprises a master information block, MIB, including an indication that the neighbour cell does not include a system information block 1, SIB1, comprising the CGI of the neighbour cell.

8. The method of claim 7, wherein the indication that the neighbour cell does broadcast the SIB 1 comprising the CGI is provided in a physical downlink control channel, PDCCH, ConfigSIB 1 information element, IE, of the MIB.
9. A method of operating a network node (3320) of a radio access network, RAN, wherein the network node is associated to a serving cell serving a wireless device, UE (3330), the method comprising:

10. The method of claims 9, wherein the CGI Report comprises a SIB1 presence field with a flag that indicates an absence of SIB1 and a cell identifier information field indicative of whether the UE was able or not able to detect the CGI of the neighbor cell.

11. The method of claims 10, further comprising: if the flag indicates an absence of SIB1 and the cell identifier information field is empty, transmitting (719) a notification to another node of the RAN responsive to the determining that the neighbour cell does not broadcast the CGI of the neighbour cell.

12. The method of claims 10, further comprising: if the flag indicates a presence of SIB1 and the cell identifier information field is empty, instructing a second UE to perform a CGI reporting for the neighbor cell.

13. The method of any of claims 9-12, further comprising: receiving (703) a measurement report from the UE, wherein the measurement report includes a physical cell identifier, PCI, for the neighbour cell; and wherein the request (707) is transmitted responsive to receiving the measurement report and responsive to detecting that the CGI is not being included in a neighbour relations table, NRT, for the network node, and wherein the request includes the PCI.

14. The method of any of claims 9-11, wherein the flag indicating the presence or absence of SIB is provided in a field of the cell identifier report used to provide a stand-alone/non-stand-alone indicator.
15. A wireless device, UE (3330) adapted to perform the steps of any of claims 1-8.
16. A network node (3320) of a radio access network adapted to perform the steps of any of claims 9-14.
